paper_seed_protocol.metric_definition: For each (task, seed): evaluation/success at exactly step 2000000. Then mean over seeds 0,1,2. Then mean over tasks.
paper_seed_protocol.protocol_change_note: All OGBench paper results (tables + results-gains figure) use only the final 2,000,000-step checkpoint. paper_last3 is superseded and must not be copied into paper figures, tables, or claims.
paper_seed_protocol.ablation_budget_note: Ablations use a common shorter budget than 2M when ablation_budget=1000000 < 2000000; they use only the exact final checkpoint at that budget. Label clearly and never compare mismatched budgets as equivalent or use 1M ablations as final-2M OGBench results.

ablations.budget_label: final_checkpoint_at_1000k (exact step 1000000; SHORTER THAN 2M PAPER PROTOCOL)

full.description: Full ConsensusFlow/v9 defaults (OGBench HL tasks; reuse @1M)

lambda02_crf.description: guidance_coef=0.2 with standard CRF gates (conflict_power=2, residual_coef=0.25, consensus_floor=0.01)

lambda10_crf.description: guidance_coef=1.0 with standard CRF gates (conflict_power=2, residual_coef=0.25, consensus_floor=0.01)

lambda02.description: guidance_coef=0.2 under no-CRF safety-off (conflict_power=0, residual_coef=0, consensus_floor=0)

lambda10.description: guidance_coef=1.0 under no-CRF safety-off (conflict_power=0, residual_coef=0, consensus_floor=0)

no_conflict.description: conflict_power=0 → kill_frac=1-trust^0=0 for all trust (disables trust-weighted BC-conflict projection; residual damping remains)

no_residual.description: residual_coef=0 (disables residual damping when BC aligns)

no_floor.description: consensus_floor=0 disables the batch-relative scale-free floor (closest controlled switch). Distill target remains q_grad/(||q_grad||+1e-6) unit normalization; not a raw-gradient ablation.

no_crf.description: Combined safety-off ablation: conflict_power=0, residual_coef=0, consensus_floor=0 (guidance_coef retained at 0.5); reuse OGBench-50 @1M

k2.description: ensemble_ct=2 with default gates (conflict_power=2, residual_coef=0.25, consensus_floor=0.01)

k20.description: ensemble_ct=20 with default gates (conflict_power=2, residual_coef=0.25, consensus_floor=0.01)

ablations.protocol_note: Table-4 protocol: OGBench humanoidmaze-large tasks 1–5, seeds 0–2, exact final checkpoint at 1000000. Per seed, success is the mean over the five tasks; table mean±std is over those seed means. full/no_crf reuse existing OGBench-50 run groups at the same step.
